name: pumperly
description: Open-source fuel price comparison and EV route planner with real-time prices across 36 countries. Combines route planning with fuel stations and EV chargers, featuring detour calculation and "cheapest within N minutes" filtering. Multi-language (16 languages), multi-currency. Requires PostgreSQL with PostGIS extension. Optional Valhalla (routing) and Photon (geocoding) containers for full functionality. Note: Full setup with Valhalla tiles requires ~300 GB disk and ~24 GB RAM during tile building. More info: https://github.com/GeiserX/pumperly
